name: Trouble In Darkshore?
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
How nice it is to see a champion interested in the great archeological wonders of our world.

Oftentimes our work is dismissed as mere hobby by our friends in the Alliance. But what many fail to realize is that recent discoveries in Khaz Modan have proven that a great and powerful force threatens all of Azeroth, from Lordaeron to Kalimdor.

I am most worried about my crew that I sent to Darkshore. They haven't sent word in weeks.

Travel to Auberdine and look for a clue as to their whereabouts.
narrative.objectives: Travel to Auberdine and look for signs of the dwarven excavation team.
narrative.offerRewardText: I'm so glad Chief Archeologist Greywhisker sent for us....
